newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Drill report boosts Australia's Gawler stocks.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Drill report boosts Australia's Gawler stocks.

text.p: Shares in mineral explorers with interests in the Gawler Craton gold region in South Australia soared in early trade on Wednesday after Helix Resources NL released a drilling report confirming additional significant gold mineralisation at its Lake Everard project.
Helix shares soared A$1.15 to an intraday high of A$3.00, a more than six-fold increase on its 45 cent price before the initial report that sparked interest in the area on November 18.

Other companies with interests in the Gawler Craton region include Grenfell Resources NL which jumped eight cents to 72 cents, Equinox Resources NL, whose shares surged 11 cents to 71 cents, Minotaur Gold NL, which climbed eight cents to 69 cents and Lakes Oil NL, which added two percent to five cents.
